name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'If you pick up the key, you must also open the door' is an if-condition with the no-timing cue 'also', so RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) is the right template. 'must' with no preference cue makes it hard. No goal is commanded, so no Existence is needed and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: If the agent picks up the key, it must also open the door at some point (no timing required).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
